grains.question_concept: one governed semantic question meaning across one or more implementations
grains.question_implementation: one exact source-family + wave + instrument-scope + source-variable implementation
grains.response_binding: one accepted response-authority binding for one implementation
grains.source_structure: one source-native grouping observed in one wave/instrument scope

identity_rules.question_concept_id: stable human-governed semantic ID; new version for meaning/evidence-ceiling change
identity_rules.question_implementation_id: question concept + source family + wave + instrument scope + source variable; new version for wording/routing/response binding or applicability change
identity_rules.source_variable_case: case-preserving exact identity; lowercase may be stored only as a search key and never as canonical identity
identity_rules.semantic_annotations: non-governing discovery features; changes do not alter question authority identity unless independently approved upstream
identity_rules.array_order: source_structure member order is documentary unless an explicit later family implementation assigns semantic order

population_rule: P2 is populated from original/canonical codebooks plus accepted question and response authorities. Smoke selections, QSM heuristics, embeddings, and diagnostics may annotate or suggest but never define membership or authority.
